verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents Deployments as a containers-as-a-service offering for running container images and serving ML models. That is the product's own managed way to deploy code without hand-managing VMs, but the evidence never mentions autoscaling, scale-to-zero, or per-request serverless billing. Machine auto-shutdown is an adjacent VM idle-stop feature and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented autoscaling of GPU workers, scale-to-zero behavior, serverless per-usage billing, GPU-backed Deployment specifics, and any hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy code to autoscaling serverless GPU workers that scale to zero, instead of managing always-on instances

citations.quote: Deployments are containers-as-a-service that let you run container images and serve machine learning models.
